command:
kubectl -n kof get svc | grep -E 'grafana|opencost'
cat /tmp/qa-grafana-forward.log
kubectl -n kof get pods | grep -v 'Running' || true
kubectl --kubeconfig=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig -n kof logs daemonset/kof-collectors-daemon-collector --since=2m --all-pods=true | grep -E 'error|failed' | tail -8 || true
